prompt:
The identity of record: THE CAMOUFLAGED ELEVATOR found and alive, seen front-on from a few steps back at ground level in a small jungle clearing. One rounded car matching the attached elevation drawing exactly: glass upper two-thirds in a warm brass frame with rounded corners, cream lower body, a sliding double door on the front standing OPEN with a seam down the middle, warm golden light filling the glass and spilling onto a low round stone platform half swallowed by ferns and moss. Above the car, a brass collar, and through it a slender SILVER RIBBON about a hand's width rising dead vertical out of the top of the frame into the leaves. To either side, living vines drawn aside like a curtain, as if just pulled back. Inside, the light suggests a few simple seats; no instruments, no screens. The mood is quiet invitation, a secret shown to a friend. Soft ink-and-wash illustration with visible brushwork and watercolor paper texture in leaves, brass and glass alike. The elevation drawing is layout reference only: never paint its lines, dashes, dimensions or labels into the image. No text anywhere.

NEGATIVES, none of these may appear: a truss tower, pylon, scaffold, crane or rope in place of the ribbon; a hinged house door on the car; lettering, signage or numbers anywhere; broken or shattered glass in any state; ominous mood or horror gloom; neon light, chrome gloss; photoreal rendering; 3D/CGI gloss.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
